say:2:1041501901:1.text: Oh, Viperian. Is the experiment going well?
say:2:1041501901:1.source_cn: 哦，维珀里安，最近实验顺利吗？

say:3:1041501902:1.text: Well? No, just the opposite. I must conduct it on a grander scale but cannot find capable help.
say:3:1041501902:1.source_cn: 顺利？不，恰恰相反，我需要大型实验，但根本找不到可用之才。

say:4:1041501903:1.text: I had to go through several batches before settling on a barely adequate handful of fools, who aren't fit to be deemed assistants yet.
say:4:1041501903:1.source_cn: 我处理了好几拨没用的废物，才总算调教出一批勉强能派上用...

say:5:1041501904:1.text: The inept buffoons used the wrong components yesterday and wasted half of the precious souls before I discovered their mistake!
say:5:1041501904:1.source_cn: 结果这帮蠢货，昨天选错了实验材料，一大批宝贵的灵魂被临...

say:6:1041501905:1.text: Well, if they're that bad, turn them over to me.
say:6:1041501905:1.source_cn: 呵呵，要是那批手下不好用，不如移交给我吧。

say:7:1041501906:1.text: This scythe of mine has been thirsty for a long time...
say:7:1041501906:1.source_cn: 这柄敛魂的镰刀，已经饥渴难耐了……
